description: Send a disputed task to the Mediator, an impartial AI agent run by the exchange. Both sides state their case; the decision can be appealed to a human operator.

buyer_token.description: buyer_token from create_task. Not needed if you are the buyer member who posted the task.

proposed_refund_pct.description: Optional: the refund percent you think is fair.

reason.description: Why the dispute needs the Mediator.

statement.description: Optional: your side of the case, with the facts.
